thread:
Cassie: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from the all-hands. A few folks asked for clearer priorities across API / Console / Optimize. Can leaders help map priority buckets -> rough shipment windows so we can sync OKRs?
Vikram: happy to. High-level: 1) Production readiness (SLAs, retries, fallback) 2) Developer UX (Console flows, error surfaces) 3) Cost tooling (Optimize recommendations). We can align dates after owners confirm.
Diego: asking for clarification — does "developer UX" include the new per-route trace view demoed today?
Vikram: yes — per-route trace is in the Developer UX bucket, targeted for an alpha in ~6 wks.
Hannah: for Roadmap transparency — can we publish a short table in the Console notes: bucket, owner, canary window, GA window? That would help PMs and SEs.
Jonah: +1. From eng: we need to lock dependencies (backend trace indexing + small infra for trace retention). If owners are happy with alpha in 6 wks, canary in 10, GA in 16.
Cassie: that timeline sounds good as a draft. What about API surface changes (batching params, new retry headers) — were those in Production readiness?
Vikram: yes. Batching params v1 (simple batch_size and timeout) -> beta in 8 wks. Retry headers (x-redwood-retry) are lower-risk and we can ship earlier as opt-in in 4 wks.
Diego: from runtime side, we need a short lead to validate batching defaults against our latency SLOs. Suggest a 2-week perf validation sprint starting next Monday. @Hannah can you coordinate test prompts?
Hannah: can do. I'll post a short prompt set + traffic mix in #eng-runtime by EOD.
Cassie: Optimize questions: will the initial recommendations be rules-based or ML-driven?
Vikram: initial release will be rules-based hints (quantization suggestions, cache configs) in 12 wks; ML-driven suggestion engine is Q3 work after we collect telemetry.
Jonah: note on Dedicated customers — we should surface any breaking config changes with a migration guide and a deprecation timeline. I'll draft a template and share.
Cassie: Actions: Hannah to publish table (bucket/owner/canary/GA) by Thursday; Diego to start perf sprint Monday; Jonah to draft migration template by next Tue; Vikram to finalize high-level buckets and confirm dates by EOD Wednesday.
allhands-bot: :white_check_mark: Action items recorded. Use /followup to add more.
Cassie: thanks — if there are objections to any windows call them out here or ping me directly.
Diego: no objections from runtime team.
Hannah: adding PMs for visibility.
Vikram: will confirm vendor dependencies (third-party tracing lib) before Wednesday.
Cassie: perfect, closing thread for now. If anything changes please reply and we'll update the Console notes.
